団体の API キーです。書式は `ewk_` と 43 字の英数字です。: The organization's API key. The format is `ewk_` followed by 43 alphanumeric characters.
団体のサイトや道具から、EventWatch の投稿を読み書きする API です: An API for reading and writing EventWatch posts from an organization's site or tools.
AI が作った下書きと差し戻しを新しい順に返します。例: page=0&size: Returns AI-created drafts and posts returned for changes, newest first. Example: page=0&size=20. The maximum size is 100. Posts whose editing has moved to an external site are not included.
下書きを作ります（201）。`Idempotency-Key` は必須で、同じ値: Creates a draft (201). `Idempotency-Key` is required. A retry with the same value returns the existing post instead of creating another (200). The same value with different content returns 422 (code=idempotencyKeyReused). The value is valid for 72 hours. If the organization has 50 unsubmitted drafts, the response is 409 (code=aiDraftLimitExceeded).
同じ値の再送で、既存の投稿を返します。: A retry with the same value. Returns the existing post.
差し戻しの理由を含みます。無い・他団体・人が作った投稿は 404 です。AI が: Includes the reason the post was returned for changes. Returns 404 if the post doesn't exist, belongs to another organization, or was created by a person. An AI-created post returns 409 (code=draftNotEditable) unless it is a draft or returned for changes, and 409 (code=eventManagedExternally) if its editing source is an external site.
送った項目だけを変えます。null と省略は変えず、空（`\"\"`・`tagI: Changes only the fields you send. null and omitted fields stay as they are; empty values (`""`, `tagIds: []`) clear a field. The review status doesn't change. Which posts can be updated is determined the same way as for getting a draft.
キーの団体の投稿のうち、まだ結び付いていないもの（外部の出所が無い・切り離し中）: Returns the posts of the key's organization that aren't linked yet (no external source, or detached), newest first. Soft-deleted posts are excluded; there is no filtering by review status or event date. Example: page=0&size=20. The maximum size is 100. Linking a post removes it from the list and shifts positions, so read page=0 again when importing several in a row.
パートは `file` と `purpose`（`ownedEventImage: The parts are `file` and `purpose` (`ownedEventImage` or `ownedEventDescriptionImage`). Each organization can upload 100 images per 24 hours; beyond that the response is 409. Unsupported formats and sizes return 400.
キーはヘッダー `X-EW-Api-Key` で送ります（`Authorizat: Send the key in the `X-EW-Api-Key` header (not in `Authorization`). Returns 401 if the key is missing, unknown, or revoked; 403 (code=organizationSuspended) if EventWatch has suspended the organization; and 400 if it is sent together with another credential such as Bearer.
プラグインのアンインストールで送ります。掲載は続き、EventWatch の画面: Sent when the plugin is uninstalled. Listings continue and become editable on EventWatch. Returns 204 even if there are no posts. Returns 403 (code=siteBoundToAnotherKey) if another key that sent this site has not been revoked.
論理削除します。既に削除した投稿も 204 です。無ければ 404 です。そのサ: Soft-deletes the post. Returns 204 even if the post is already deleted, and 404 if it doesn't exist. Returns 403 (code=siteBoundToAnotherKey) if another key that sent this site has not been revoked.
審査の状態・差し戻しの理由・掲載の有無・スラッグを返します。無い・他団体・論理削: Returns the review status, the reason the post was returned for changes, whether it is listed, and its slug. Returns 404 if the post doesn't exist, belongs to another organization, or was soft-deleted.
無ければ作成して提出します（201）。あれば全置換します（200）。掲載中は審査: Creates and submits the post if it doesn't exist (201); otherwise replaces it entirely (200). A listed post doesn't go back to review, a post awaiting review stays awaiting review, posts returned for changes and drafts are submitted, and private posts become public again. For a post EventWatch has stopped, only the content is updated. If `sourceUpdatedAt` is earlier than the stored value, nothing is applied and `applied=false` is returned. A soft-deleted identifier returns 409 (code=eventDeleted). `siteUrl` and `adminUrl` are optional; if omitted, the previous values are kept (`http` or `https` URLs, up to 1024 characters). Returns 403 (code=siteBoundToAnotherKey) if another key that sent this site has not been revoked.
取り込みで使います。結び付けた投稿は EventWatch の画面で編集できなく: Used for importing. A linked post can no longer be edited on EventWatch and is updated through sync from then on. The review status doesn't change. A retry with the same pair returns 200. Returns 404 if the post doesn't exist, belongs to another organization, or was soft-deleted. Returns 409 (code=externalIdentifierInUse) if the identifier is used by another post, and 409 (code=eventAlreadyLinked) if the post is linked to another identifier. `siteUrl` and `adminUrl` are optional; if omitted, the previous values are kept (`http` or `https` URLs, up to 1024 characters). Returns 403 (code=siteBoundToAnotherKey) if another key that sent this site has not been revoked.
団体の投稿をサイトの投稿へ結び付ける: Link an organization's post to a site's post
掲載中は非公開へ、審査待ちは下書きへ。ほかの状態と EventWatch が止め: A listed post becomes private, and a post awaiting review becomes a draft. Other statuses and posts EventWatch has stopped are left as they are. Returns 404 if the post doesn't exist. Returns 403 (code=siteBoundToAnotherKey) if another key that sent this site has not been revoked.
